  - text: CLASS 9 · EUCLIDEAN GEOMETRY
  - heading "Triangle Angle Sum Theorem" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Discover and prove that a triangle's interior angles total 180°.
  - text: ◷ 30 min RIGOROUS PROOF geometry2d
  - link "School lessons":
    - /url: /lessons/school
    - img
    - text: School lessons
  - navigation:

  - main:
    - heading "1. EXPLORE & DISCOVER" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag any vertex to change the triangle. Arrange the three angles on a straight line.
    - article:
      - button "Reset triangle":
        - img
        - text: Reset triangle
      - img "Interactive triangle angle sum diagram": A 48° B 67° C 65°
      - text: 💡 Drag vertices A, B, or C to explore acute, right, and obtuse triangles.
    - complementary:
      - heading "ANGLE MEASURES (live)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: ∠A = 48°
      - paragraph: ∠B = 67°
      - paragraph: ∠C = 65°
      - heading "SUM METER" [level=3]
      - strong: 48° + 67° + 65° = 180°
      - progressbar
      - text: Perfect! The sum is 180°.
    - heading "2. TEAR & REARRANGE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag each colored angle to the line below to form a straight line.
    - button "Clear line":
      - img
      - text: Clear line
    - text: 48° 67° 65° 180° △
    - heading "THEOREM" [level=2]
    - paragraph: For every Euclidean triangle ABC,
    - strong: ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°.
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Draw a line through vertex C parallel to side AB.
      - paragraph: The alternate interior angles formed equal ∠A and ∠B.
      - paragraph: These three adjacent angles on a straight line sum to 180°.
      - img: A B C l
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: If ∠A = 48° and ∠B = 67°, find ∠C.
      - paragraph: ∠C = 180° − (48° + 67°)
      - paragraph: ∠C = 180° − 115°
      - paragraph: ∠C = 65°
      - img: 48° 67° 65°
    - heading "💡 COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=2]
    - paragraph: The sum of the angles is not always 180°.
    - paragraph: "Reality: The sum of the interior angles of any Euclidean triangle is always 180°, whether the triangle is acute, right, obtuse, scalene, or isosceles."
    - figure:
      - img: 55° 53° 72°
      - text: Acute 180°
    - figure:
      - img: 42° 48° 90°
      - text: Right 180°
    - figure:
      - img: 30° 40° 110°
      - text: Obtuse 180°
    - heading "◎ CHALLENGE YOURSELF" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Drag vertex C through acute, right, and obtuse cases. Keep the sum verified.
    - button "⟳ Try it now"
